Subject: Minutes + action items — MeridianCloud SIG intake (4/2)

Anika / Devon — thanks for the call earlier today. Minutes and next steps below.

Quick recap:
- Meeting type: SIG/CAIQ intake (remote)
- Duration: 60 minutes
- Internal Redwoods on call: Dylan (solutions), Kimberly (security/compliance lead), Marissa (CS/evidence)
- Meridian attendees: Anika (security), Devon (platform), brief presence from compliance manager

Key clarifications we captured:
- Scope: Reviewing Redwood Hosted API + Dedicated (reserved) deployment modes. Meridian to confirm whether Private on-prem is in-scope (action: Meridian).
- Audit logs: Redwood will supply sample log extracts and a redaction checklist. For hosted API, default retention is 90 days; Dedicated can be configured. (Action: Kimberly to upload log samples and redaction checklist)
- Data residency: Redwood supports region pinning; we documented where region-specific storage occurs and will share the flow diagram. (Action: Dylan to share flow diagram link)
- KMS / CMK: Redwood supports customer-managed keys via KMS integrations in Dedicated/Private. We captured the high-level lifecycle and will provide a short KMS FAQ. (Action: Marissa to draft KMS FAQ)
- Incident/RCA windows: Standard notification SLA is 24 hours for P1; formal RCA timeline is 7 business days. Meridian requested examples of past incident communication templates — we will provide anonymized templates. (Action: Dylan to share templates)

Action items and owners:
- Meridian: confirm final scope (hosted/dedicated/private) and return updated prefill by 2027-04-06.
- Kimberly: upload audit log samples + redaction checklist to secure Drive by 2027-04-05.
- Marissa: KMS FAQ + list of supported KMS providers by 2027-04-07.
- Dylan: flow diagram for data residency + anonymized incident templates by 2027-04-05.

Attachments: Meeting_Minutes_20270402.pdf (summary + action register), Redwood_Precall_CAiq_Packet_v1.xlsx (updated with call notes).

If this looks good I'll push the Drive links and HubSpot record and we can re-open the thread for any clarifications.

Best,
Dylan
